dict.string: J.A.R.V.I.S. controls Mail, Calendar, Notes, Photos, Music and your windows when you ask it to.
J.A.R.V.I.S. reads your calendar to brief you, answer questions about your day and tell you when to leave.
J.A.R.V.I.S. reads your calendar to brief you, answer questions about your day and tell you when to leave.
J.A.R.V.I.S. looks people up in your Contacts when you ask it to message, email or call someone.

J.A.R.V.I.S. shows your camera in the Command Center when you turn it on (nothing is recorded or sent). A website in its built-in browser gets the camera only after you allow that site, as for a video call.
J.A.R.V.I.S. lets your iPhone and Apple Watch find this Mac and talk to it on your network, once you turn the companion on.
J.A.R.V.I.S. uses your location for local weather and traffic-aware travel times. A website in its built-in browser gets it only after you allow that site.

J.A.R.V.I.S. listens for its name and when you tap the orb or press Option-Space. A website in its built-in browser gets the microphone only after you allow that site.
J.A.R.V.I.S. reads your open reminders into your second brain when you turn Reminders on, and adds, ticks off or deletes one when you ask it to (deleting asks first).
